answer: The beacon schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the jetty checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 54 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An copycat wanting 57 effective identities must lock that capital for 54 epochs and keep it locked through every hollow audit. That is 11 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
